svg.title: The Slums / street study
svg.desc: Painterly eye-level view east-north-east down the 4 m slum lane outside the south wall: low patched houses, laundry, worn puddled setts, a dark 3 m side alley, the 10 m town wall and the main gatehouse above the roofline, town roofs and the cathedral beyond. Warm low autumn sun from upper left.
svg.text: High autumn / low warm sun from upper left / outside the south wall, eye height 1.65 m, looking west down the lane toward the river meadow.
Low patched roofs under the 10 m wall: laundry across the lane, repaired, inhabited, and 3 m back alleys dropping into shadow.
3.5–7 m houses / 280 cm storeys / smoked oak, patched cream over ochre, rough stone bases, old tile and plank repairs / no awnings, no docks, no open flame.
Composed V5 mood study, not a measured capture: distant town roofs and the cathedral are lifted slightly so they read above the wall.
CONCEPT / NOVEMBER 2026 • PROPOSED, NOT AN ENGINE CAPTURE • G = 10 cm / B = 200 cm
